name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A coding-agent add-on that stops AI from writing bloated, over-engineered code — it pushes the AI toward the smallest, simplest fix instead of showing off.
buyer: An engineering lead at a startup who's watched AI coding assistants balloon a small bug fix into a 500-line refactor and wants the bill and the codebase both kept small.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO installs it org-wide so every engineer's AI agent defaults to minimal, reviewable diffs instead of sprawling rewrites.
A dev-tools consultant sells it as part of an 'AI coding cost audit' for companies whose AI token bills have crept up.
An open-source maintainer requires contributors' AI agents to use it before submitting PRs, to keep the codebase lean.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid benchmarking service: measure a company's AI-generated code bloat before/after adopting it, sold as a report plus rollout.
Build a hosted dashboard that tracks code-size and cost savings across a team's repos over time, sold as a subscription.

steal_this: Build a simple before/after 'lines of code and token cost saved' report generator this weekend and pitch it free to a few dev teams as a lead magnet for consulting.
